summary: Pebblebrook Hotel Trust filed an 8-K reporting Q2 2026 results and announcing a new $50.0 million preferred share repurchase program authorized July 24, 2026, to start after the current $100.0 million program (with $45.6 million available) is completed. The new program covers Series E, F, G, and H preferred shares, with aggregate liquidation value eligible at $639.5 million. No price, timing, or expiration is set; repurchases will be at the company's discretion. This is a capital return via preferred buybacks. Watch for execution pace and impact on preferred yields.
